children: New Delhi, Oct. 30 -- Reliance Industries Limited Q2 Results: Mukesh Ambani's Reliance Industries Limited (RIL) reported its strongest-ever quarterly revenue growth in the second quarter of financial year 2026-27. RIL's consolidated net profit (attributable to owners of the company) increased by 40% on an annual basis to Rs.25,548 crore in Q2FY27.
RIL's consolidated revenue from operations increased to Rs.3,32,861 crore during the quarter under review.

RIL reported a net profit after tax (PAT) of Rs.29,250 crore in Q2FY27. Its profit (attributable to owners of the company) stood at Rs.25,548 crore, which is 40.64% higher than Rs.18,165 crore reported in the year ago period. RIL's net profit stood at Rs.20,946 crore.
Revenue from operations stood at Rs.3.32 lakh crore in Q2FY 27 against Rs.2.59 lakh crore reported in the year ago period. Its revenue from operations stood at Rs.3.11 lakh crore.

The oil-to-conglomerate recorded quarterly EBITDA at Rs.62,409 crore, up 23.9% on an annual basis. Mukesh Ambani-led RIL reported its best ever O2C business performance as EBITDA was up 67.9% on an annual basis to Rs.25,203 crore. The digital services EBITDA stood at Rs.22,223 crore up 17.7% on an annual basis.

RRVL's net revenue increased 6.4% annually to Rs.91,716 crore. Its EBITDA margin stood at 7.8%, whereas quarterly EBITDA stood at Rs.6,228 crore. The company reported a net profit of Rs.2,619 crore during the quarter under review against Rs.3,469 reported in Q2FY26.
The stock closed 0.44% higher at Rs.1163.55 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of Rs.15,74,578.54 crore on Friday.
